text: The Patriots' dominant 45-17 victory over the Raiders came at a significant cost, as left tackle Will Campbell suffered an MCL sprain in his right knee that will sideline him for multiple games, while running back TreVeyon Henderson's high ankle sprain is expected to keep him out for several weeks as well—a pair of injuries that threaten to test the depth of an offense that nonetheless looked formidable on Sunday with Drake Maye accounting for five total touchdowns despite missing his top receiver and facing a secondary depleted by the absence of both starting cornerbacks. In response to the roster strain, the Patriots signed running back Hassan Haskins and cornerback D'Shawn Jamison to the practice squad while releasing linebacker Jose Ramirez, a modest reshuffling that hints at how the team will navigate the injury avalanche heading forward. Off the field, Patriots legends Andre Tippett and Julian Edelman are set for induction into the International Jewish Sports Hall of Fame's Class of 2026, adding another chapter to their storied legacies.
